### Action Rationale

ETHA is the highest-quality vehicle for ETH exposure (BlackRock, $5.9B AUM, 0.25% expense ratio) but three gates must be cleared before initiating: (1) target weight must be set in target-portfolio.json — currently 0%; (2) ETH must show relative strength improvement vs BTC — ETH -32% YTD while BTC is significantly positive is a structural concern; (3) staking yield is NOT passed through in spot ETFs — you hold ETH at full price risk without the 3-4% staking APY that on-chain holders receive, which is a meaningful opportunity cost. Price near 52w low ($12.88 vs $11.62 low) is interesting for a contrarian position, but the -65% drawdown from 52w high ($36.80) reflects genuine ETH-specific weakness, not just a pullback.

### Upside Catalysts

- SEC approves ETH ETF staking yield pass-through — transforms ETHA from price-only to yield-bearing
- Ethereum Pectra/future upgrade drives renewed developer and DeFi activity — ETH narrative reset
- BTC dominance cycle peaks and rotation into ETH begins — ETH historically outperforms BTC in alt seasons
- Institutional adoption of Ethereum smart contracts for tokenized assets (bonds, funds) — demand catalyst
- Near 52w low ($11.62) — price compression may already reflect most of the downside

### Risks

- ETH -32% YTD vs BTC significantly positive in 2026 — structural underperformance, not a temporary dip
- No staking yield pass-through — on-chain ETH earns 3-4% APY; ETHA earns 0% plus 0.25% fee drag
- Target weight is 0% — no initiation without an explicit committee decision to allocate
- 65% drawdown from 52w high ($36.80 to $12.88) — single-asset concentration risk fully exposed
- Ethereum competes with alternative L1s (Solana, Sui, Aptos) for DeFi activity — market share erosion
- If BTC dominance continues rising, ETH may continue underperforming for extended period

### Entry Note

Do not initiate until: (1) target weight >0% is explicitly set, AND (2) ETH/BTC ratio shows recovery. If initiating, a limit around $11.50 (just above 52w low) is the disciplined entry. Maximum 1-2% of portfolio given single-asset concentration risk. Monitor SEC staking yield ruling — approval would materially change the thesis.
